# Initial Set Up
```{r}
# uncomment for mac 
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
Sys.setenv(RGL_USE_NULL = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(qpcR)
source("../class_resources/plot.roots.R")
set.seed(13)
```


# Reading in Data
```{r}
# reading in original data
team_stats <- read.csv('../data/TeamStatistics.csv')

# formatting data as monthly averages of free throw 
fta_monthly <- team_stats %>%
  # only looking at Regular Season games
  filter(gameType == "Regular Season") %>%
  
  # formatting as monthly events
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(as_date(gameDate), "month")) %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
  
  # average fta per month
  summarise(fta_monthly = mean(freeThrowsAttempted, na.rm = T),
            n_games = n()) %>%
  
  # filtering out seasons before year 1980 and after 2019
  filter(year_month >= "1990-10-1", year_month < "2019-10-1") %>%
  
  mutate(m = month(year_month), 
         season = if_else(m >= 10, year(year_month), year(year_month) - 1L))
```
## which months to drop
```{r}
table(fta_monthly$m)
```

drop 5, 10
5 and 10 don't have many appearances compared to the other months
done to simplify project

```{r}
ts_fta <- fta_monthly %>%
  filter(!(m %in% c(5,10))) %>%
  arrange(year_month) %>%
  pull(fta_monthly) %>% 
  ts()
```

## Splitting Data Into Training/Testing Sets
```{r}
ts_train <- ts_fta[1:162]
ts_test <- ts_fta[163:168]
```

We will be predicting the 2019 regular season free throw attempts.

# Plotting and Analyzing Training Set

## Initial Plot
```{r}
# initial plot
plot.ts(ts_train, type = "l", xlab = "Time (Months)",
        ylab = "Average Free Throws Attempts", 
        main = "Average Free Throw Attempts per Month")

# initial histogram
hist(ts_train, xlab = "")
```

appears to a linear trend and changing variance 

# Transforming and Differencing Series
## Checking if box-cox transformation is necessary
```{r}
t <- 1:length(ts_train)

bc_fta <- boxcox(ts_train ~ t)

# obtaining estimate and C.I. of lambda
bc_fta$x[which(bc_fta$y == max(bc_fta$y))]

ts_fta_bc <- log(ts_train)
```

$\hat\lambda$'s confidence interval contains 0, which means the transformation we should use is log transformation. 

## decomposition of series
```{r}
y <- ts(as.numeric(ts_fta_bc), frequency = 6)

decomp <- decompose(y)

plot(decomp)
```


## differencing selection
```{r}
ts_fta_bc_d1 <- diff(ts_fta_bc, lag = 1)
var(ts_fta_bc_d1)

ts_fta_bc_d1_1 <- diff(ts_fta_bc_d1, lag = 1)
var(ts_fta_bc_d1_1)

ts_fta_bc_d6 <- diff(ts_fta_bc, lag = 6)
var(ts_fta_bc_d6)

ts_fta_bc_d1_6 <- diff(ts_fta_bc_d1, lag = 6)
var(ts_fta_bc_d1_6)
```
differencing at lag 1 once has the lowest variance so we will select $d=1$

```{r}
plot.ts(ts_fta_bc_d1)
hist(ts_fta_bc_d1)

plot.ts(ts_fta_bc_d1_6)
hist(ts_fta_bc_d1_6)
```
# Estimating model

```{r}
acf(ts_fta_bc_d1, lag.max = 50)

acf(ts_fta_bc_d1_6, lag.max = 50)
pacf(ts_fta_bc_d1_6, lag.max = 50)
```

## Estimating Parameters (ts_fta_bc_d1)
### SARIMA(2, 1, 1) (0, 0, 2)6
```{r}
# SARIMA(2, 1, 1) (0, 0, 2)6
(SARIMA211_002_6 <- arima(ts_fta_bc, order = c(2, 1, 1), 
      seasonal = list(order = c(0, 0, 2), period = 6),
      method = "ML"))
AICc(SARIMA211_002_6)

(SARIMA211_002_6_0Check <- arima(ts_fta_bc, order = c(2, 1, 1), 
      seasonal = list(order = c(0, 0, 2), period = 6),
      transform.pars = F, 
      fixed = c(NA, 0 , NA, 0, NA),
      method = "ML"))
AICc(SARIMA211_002_6_0Check)
```

# Diagnostic Checking

3 smallest models
from smallest AICc to bigget AICc

## SARIMA(0, 1, 1) (0, 0, 2)6, 0 Checked
```{r}
res1 <- residuals(SARIMA011_002_6_0Check)

plot(res1, type = "l")

hist(res1)

qqnorm(res1)
qqline(res1)

acf(res1, lag.max = 50)
pacf(res1, lag.max = 50)

h1 <- round(sqrt(length(res1)))

ar(res1, aic = TRUE, order.max = NULL, method = c("yule-walker"))

shapiro.test(res1)
Box.test(res1, lag = h1, type = "Box-Pierce", fitdf = 2)
Box.test(res1, lag = h1, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 2)
Box.test(res1^2, lag = h1, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 0)
```

## SARIMA(2, 1, 1) (0, 0, 2)6, 0 Checked
```{r}
res2 <- residuals(SARIMA211_002_6_0Check)

plot(res2, type = "l")

hist(res2)

qqnorm(res2)
qqline(res2)

acf(res2, lag.max = 50)
pacf(res2, lag.max = 50)

h2 <- round(sqrt(length(res2)))

ar(res2, aic = TRUE, order.max = NULL, method = c("yule-walker"))

shapiro.test(res2)
Box.test(res2, lag = h2, type = "Box-Pierce", fitdf = 3)
Box.test(res2, lag = h2, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 3)
Box.test(res2^2, lag = h2, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 0)
```

## SARIMA(0, 1, 1) (0, 0, 2)6
```{r}
res3 <- residuals(SARIMA011_002_6)
```

# Forecast

```{r}
final_model <- SARIMA011_002_6_0Check

# predicting 6 steps ahead
pred.tr <- predict(final_model, n.ahead = 6)
```

## Forecast on Transformed Data
```{r}
# upper and lower bounds
U.tr <- pred.tr$pred + 2*pred.tr$se
L.tr <- pred.tr$pred - 2*pred.tr$se

# forecast on transformed data
ts.plot(ts_fta_bc, xlim = c(1,length(ts_fta_bc) + 6), ylim = c(min(ts_fta_bc, L.tr), max(U.tr, ts_fta_bc)))
lines(U.tr, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
lines(L.tr, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
points((length(ts_fta_bc) + 1):(length(ts_fta_bc)+6), pred.tr$pred, col = "#F88158")
```
## Forecast on Original Series
```{r}
# forecast on original series
pred.orig <- exp(pred.tr$pred)
U = exp(U.tr)
L = exp(L.tr)

ts.plot(ts_train, xlim = c(1,length(ts_train) + 6), ylim = c(min(ts_train, L), max(U, ts_train)))
lines(U, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
lines(L, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
points((length(ts_train) + 1):(length(ts_train)+6), pred.orig, col = "#F88158")
```

## Zoom in on Original Series
```{r}
# zoom in on original series
ts.plot(ts_train, xlim = c(150,length(ts_train) + 6), ylim = c(min(ts_train, L), max(U, ts_train)))
lines(U, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
lines(L, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
points((length(ts_train) + 1):(length(ts_train)+6), pred.orig, col = "#F88158")
```

## Zoom in Forecasts and True Values
```{r}
ts.plot(ts_fta, xlim = c(150,length(ts_train) + 6), ylim = c(min(ts_train, L), max(U, ts_train)))
lines(U, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")
lines(L, col = "#0000CD", lty = "dashed")

points((length(ts_train) + 1):(length(ts_train)+6), pred.orig, col = "#F88158")
```
